name: MongoDB
description: MongoDB makes a document database that stores data as flexible JSON-like records, popular with developers building modern applications. Most revenue (73% in FY2026) comes from Atlas, the database run as a managed cloud service on AWS, Azure and Google Cloud and billed by consumption (compute, storage, data transfer). About 20% is Enterprise Advanced, licensed software customers run themselves under annual subscription. The rest is services and other. It has more than 70,600 customers, 2,999 of them above $100K of annual recurring revenue. The big cloud providers it runs on are also among its main competitors (Amazon's DocumentDB emulates MongoDB's interface). CJ Desai is CEO.

hq.note: Principal executive office in New York, NY (search coverage of the FY2026 10-K)

businessLines.name: Atlas (managed cloud database)
businessLines.how: Pay-as-you-go cloud billing: customers are charged for the compute, storage and network their databases consume each month, so revenue rises as their applications get more traffic and as workloads migrate.

revenue.note: Atlas was 73% of total revenue in FY2026 (10-K coverage) and 73.3% of total revenue in Q2 FY2027 by arithmetic ($565.9M of $771.8M)

businessLines.revenueNote: Atlas was 73% of total revenue in FY2026 (10-K coverage) and 73.3% of total revenue in Q2 FY2027 by arithmetic ($565.9M of $771.8M)

businessLines.name: Enterprise Advanced and other subscription (self-managed licences)
businessLines.how: Annual subscription fees for software that customers run in their own data centers or private cloud, including support. Revenue recognition timing was not read.

businessLines.name: Services
businessLines.how: One-time fees for consulting and training.
